title: SQL Server integrated, 450 tables: the first update needs VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, integrated, 450 tables

symptom: PIPELINE_NON_RETRYABLE_ANALYSIS_INTERNAL_ERROR; GENERIC_SNAPSHOT_FAILURE; STREAM_FAILED: "VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE permission denied in database <database>" (SQLSTATE XXKST). "A new pipeline update will not be created."
cause: The setup utility's permission grant doesn't include it.
effect: The first update fails; 14 tables were named.
fix: GRANT VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE to the ingestion user, then start a new update.
notes: A 20-row table ran without it. Not compared at 10 and 450 tables.
